reasons.A: Short declarative sentences and clipped fragments with deadpan understatement match the passage's dry, quick rhythm and wry stance most closely, though the first-person 'I' and the repeated short-sentence runs lean slightly towards mannerism.
reasons.C: It has irony and some dialogue, but its sentences are longer and more ornate, with elaborate similes and frequent semicolons, and the jump from 'we' to 'I've' breaks the passage's plain, clipped register.
reasons.B: Long, explanatory sentences and a sympathetic, essayistic stance replace the passage's quick, ironic jottings; its tone is earnest and has little of the author's dry wit.
